annual_dataset.sample_period_rule: program measurement periods vary and remain attached to each program row

confirmed_fraud.scope: court-confirmed cases only; excludes out-of-court settlements with or without admission of guilt
confirmed_fraud.relationship_to_headline: not established as a disjoint subset; do not subtract or label the headline as fraud

agency_recovery.scope: agency-level recovery activities and recovery audits
agency_recovery.relationship_to_headline: not a direct subset of estimated program overpayments; identified and recovered amounts may span timing and recovery bases

fy2024_annual_extraction_role_review.review_scope: Governmentwide total, 68 program-result rows, 54 court-confirmed-fraud rows, and 59 agency-recovery rows from the official FY2024 annual workbook.
fy2024_annual_extraction_role_review.decision_effect: Closes the pending annual-extraction review action only; zero methodology components and fields close, no program counts change, and no scoring or claim gate changes.
fy2024_annual_extraction_role_review.allowed_use: Exact source-labeled factual composition and reconciliation with publisher, fiscal year, units, coverage qualification, program-specific measurement periods, and evidence-class labels preserved.
fy2024_annual_extraction_role_review.prohibited_use: Do not join, subtract, divide, or net confirmed-fraud or agency-recovery rows against estimated improper payments and do not infer fraud, waste, debt, collectibility, recovery, prevention, or savings.

source_reconciliation.correction_note: The prior scorecard probe used a non-resolving URL and values not present in the official PLTSS scorecard. The corrected Q4 2025 scorecard agrees with the annual workbook.

medicare_part_d_payment_type_composition.evidence_scope: The exact FY2024 annual row reports $3,052.65M overpayments, $522.44M underpayments, zero technically improper payments, and zero unknown payments, reconciling exactly to $3,575.09M improper payments; the CMS findings PDF corroborates the rounded categories and definitions.
medicare_part_d_payment_type_composition.excluded_scope: The statistical overpayment component is not identified debt, collectible dollars, recovery, collections, fraud, waste, or savings.

medicare_part_d_sponsor_documentation_de.evidence_scope: The captured scorecard corrects the Part D rate to 3.16% and full rounded root-cause amount to $3,053M; CMS findings reconcile 2.70% documentation and 0.46% drug/pricing components.
medicare_part_d_sponsor_documentation_de.open_scope: The evidence supports sponsor-data and documentation dependency rather than state data, but the full treatment remains open and Part D stays two closed/six open.

medicare_part_d_sponsor_documentation_de.evidence_scope: Same-period guide and FAQ establish required documentation, fail treatment, correction windows, final review, reconciliation cutoff, and successor responsibility; findings publish the 2.70% documentation component.
medicare_part_d_sponsor_documentation_de.excluded_scope: PDE failure and projected documentation error are not automatically monetary error, debt, collectibility, recovery, fraud, waste, or savings.

medicare_part_d_sample_design_evidence_c.supported_component_scope: Same-period sources identify PDEs as the sampled unit, describe a statistically valid stratified random sample, route selected records by sponsor contract, bind review to the CY2022 reconciliation PDE, and state OMB sampling-and-estimation-plan compliance.
medicare_part_d_sample_design_evidence_c.open_scope: Full sample design remains open because the national sample size, frame, stratum definitions, allocation, inclusion probabilities, within-stratum selection implementation, replacement and nonresponse, weights, and the relationship to the beneficiary simulation remain unpublished; Part D stays three closed/five open.

medicare_part_d_estimation_method_eviden.evidence_scope: Web extraction verifies the official APR text at printed page 88/PDF index 87 assigning each audited PDE a gross drug cost error and describing representative-beneficiary simulation; captured FY2024 findings provide OMB-plan, statistical-validity, published-output, confidence-limit, and corrected-GDC-direction evidence.
medicare_part_d_estimation_method_eviden.custody_scope: The HHS edge returned Akamai HTTP 403, so the APR has no local official-byte custody, source ID, checksum, or metadata; the CMS background page modified in 2026 is non-same-period corroboration only.
medicare_part_d_estimation_method_eviden.open_scope: Official APR custody remains blocked, and full estimation method remains open for formula, weights, PDE-to-beneficiary aggregation and sample linkage, benefit-parameter simulation, record treatment, variance and confidence-limit construction, same-period 5-percent confirmation, and rounding and reconciliation mechanics; Part D stays three closed/five open.

medicare_part_d_missing_document_exclusi.closed_component_scope: CY2022 sources establish timely incomplete/problematic-file review, unresolved Missing Documentation Form fail treatment, permitted predeadline cure for missing or invalid evidence, and FY2024 inclusion of invalid or missing documentation in the reported error category.
medicare_part_d_missing_document_exclusi.historical_scope: FY2020/CY2018 excluded 27 of 4,526 sampled PDEs lacking requested documentation; this is historical comparison only and does not establish the CY2022 rule or a COVID-19 cause.
medicare_part_d_missing_document_exclusi.open_scope: Full exclusion rules remain open for the complete taxonomy, current counts and decision stages, submission-state distinctions, post-deadline and appeal treatment, replacement and weights, estimator effects, and historical continuity; Part D stays three closed/five open.

medicare_part_d_payment_universe_measure.closed_component_scope: Same-period sources identify sampled reconciliation PDE records as the measurement object, corrected-versus-reported GDC as the error basis, and $96,521.39M in row-828 outlays as the exact value rounding to CMS's $96.52B Part D Denominator.
medicare_part_d_payment_universe_measure.open_scope: Full payment universe remains open for included/excluded streams, GDC and combined plan-beneficiary liability mapping to federal outlays, settlement and adjustment rules, covered populations and phases, double-count controls, and sample-to-denominator linkage; Part D stays three closed/five open.

medicare_part_d_audit_closeout_recovery_.closed_component_scope: The Q4 2025 scorecard documents issued Adcirca, Revatio, and Cialis audit closeout notices requiring deletion of audit-determined improper PDE records and describes that deletion as recovery; planned DME and Tepezza notices remain distinct.
medicare_part_d_audit_closeout_recovery_.open_scope: The later process has no amount or cohort linkage to the FY2024/CY2022 estimate and does not establish debt, appeal, settlement, collectibility, actual collection, write-off, liability allocation, control cost, or savings; Part D stays three closed/five open.

medicare_part_d_published_uncertainty_ou.closed_component_scope: The findings publish a 95% confidence interval of $3.19B-$4.01B and 3.31%-4.15% around the rounded $3.58B/3.70% gross result; row 828 reports $3,575.09M, rate 0.037039355, confidence label 95% to <100%, and margin-of-error value 0.42.
medicare_part_d_published_uncertainty_ou.open_scope: The 0.42 field has no disclosed units or formula and is not forced to reconcile to the findings bounds. APR custody, formula, weights, simulation, record treatment, variance, confidence-limit construction, sample linkage, and rounding remain open; Part D stays three closed/five open.

medicare_part_d_reconciliation_pde_adjus.closed_component_scope: After a sampled reconciliation PDE is adjusted, reconciliation-PDE-aligned documentation remains required and linked adjustment documentation is additionally required. The cutoff and final reconciliation target are prior Pulse 39 and Pulse 43 context, not new closure scope.
medicare_part_d_reconciliation_pde_adjus.open_scope: The guide discloses no inclusion, exclusion, denominator, weight, estimator, or payment effect for adjusted PDEs. Full payment universe remains open and Part D stays three closed/five open.

medicare_part_d_sampling_estimation_plan.evidence_scope: OMB M-21-19 requires statistically valid point and confidence-interval estimates and directs the S&EMP and checklist to the agency secure MAX page. Prior validated Part D bridges inventory the public evidence ceiling without becoming new source custody or closures.
medicare_part_d_sampling_estimation_plan.open_scope: The Part D-specific plan, checklist, appendices, version history, and reproducible sample, universe, estimator, and exclusion detail remain missing; recoverable-amount lineage is separate. Zero components and zero fields close, and Part D stays three closed/five open.

medicare_part_d_sampling_estimation_meth.request_scope: The internal draft targets the final CY2022/FY2024 Part D S&EMP, OMB checklist, incorporated attachments, operative version history, and final approval or transmittal records while excluding person-level claims, PHI, identifiers, credentials, raw inputs, production access, and the separate recovery track.
medicare_part_d_sampling_estimation_meth.open_scope: Owner authorization, requester and contact details, fee choices, scope review, and one submission channel remain unresolved. No outbound action occurred, zero components and fields close, and Part D stays three closed/five open.

medicare_part_d_sampling_estimation_meth.pipeline_scope: The hard all-false preflight, closed-world lifecycle, append-only event rules, blank intake, timing capture, appeal taxonomy, and production-review gates are ready for internal use only.
medicare_part_d_sampling_estimation_meth.open_scope: Owner authorization is necessary but insufficient; every identity, contact, fee, scope, single-channel, freeze, checksum, destination, and custody gate remains unresolved. No external action or agency evidence exists, zero components and fields close, and Part D stays three closed/five open.

open_methodology_fields: documentation defect versus recoverable overpayment basis
va_pltss_payment_type_composition_bridge.evidence_scope: The FY2024 annual row exactly reconciles overpayment, underpayment, technically improper, and unknown categories; the FY2025 AFR independently publishes the same full taxonomy for a later cycle testing payments made in FY2024.
va_pltss_payment_type_composition_bridge.excluded_scope: The two measurement cycles are not blended. Neither composition establishes bills, receivables, collectible debt, appeals, write-offs, collections, recovery, or savings.

va_pltss_documentation_recoverability_bo.evidence_scope: Current VA policy distinguishes documentation failure, unknown payment, monetary-loss overpayment, technical/non-monetary loss, and returned-funds recovery and requires actual certified funds for recovery-audit accounting.
va_pltss_documentation_recoverability_bo.open_scope: The policies postdate the tested payments and do not map PLTSS causes through category, bill, dispute, write-off, collectibility, collection, or recovery; the two-closed/six-open aggregate is unchanged.

va_pltss_same_cohort_debt_collection_lin.evidence_scope: The FY2024 annual row, Q4 2025 PLTSS scorecard, and FY2024 VA OIG review are reviewed evidence. The FY2025 AFR and current policies are later/current context and cannot assign historical sampled-payment dispositions.
va_pltss_same_cohort_debt_collection_lin.open_scope: No privacy-safe same-cohort link connects sampled payment, final classification, projection, receivable, dispute, collectibility, collection, certified cash, cost, and veteran/provider effects. Zero components and fields close and PLTSS stays two closed/six open.

federal_crop_insurance_bridge.claim_boundary: The $579.36M improper-payment estimate and its $573.93M overpayment component are statistical estimates, not identified debt, collectible recovery, fraud, waste, preventable loss, or savings.

federal_crop_insurance_payment_universe_.evidence_scope: The official FCIC/RMA FY2024 financial-statements report's Management's Discussion and Analysis on printed page 18 discloses premium subsidy, Administrative and Operating expense, and indemnities across high-, medium-, and low-payment AIP tiers.
federal_crop_insurance_payment_universe_.excluded_scope: Other Information on printed pages 60-61 is unaudited and corroborative only; its apparent $579.93M overpayment typo is excluded in favor of the official annual workbook's $573.93M.

federal_crop_insurance_root_cause_defini.evidence_scope: USDA FY2024 Agency Financial Report printed pages 216-217 defines the two FCIC root-cause categories at the same $579.36M and 2.43 percent result.
federal_crop_insurance_root_cause_defini.excluded_scope: The following USDA-wide Do Not Pay figures are not FCIC-specific; no debt, collection, recovery, prevention, or savings amount is inferred.

federal_crop_insurance_sample_design_com.closed_component_scope: FY2024 disclosures support 326 RY2022 policy units, AIP-aware selection and high/medium/low tiering, annual statistical-validity designation, and independent audit review of samples and underlying methodologies.
federal_crop_insurance_sample_design_com.open_scope: Frame construction, allocation, selection probabilities, randomization, replacement, nonresponse, weights, estimator, and variance remain open; compliance is not public reproducibility.

federal_crop_insurance_historical_sampli.closed_component_scope: FY2020 Other Information discloses a simple random policy sample, premium-subsidy, A&O-subsidy, and indemnity-payment coverage, and statistically valid rate and dollar estimates for reinsurance year 2018.
federal_crop_insurance_historical_sampli.open_scope: The historical disclosure does not establish continuity to FY2024 or publish current frame, allocation, probabilities, weights, estimators, variance, confidence interval, or detailed exclusions; the four-closed/four-open aggregate is unchanged.

federal_crop_insurance_public_methodolog.evidence_scope: OMB requires point and confidence-interval estimates and directs the S&EMP and checklist to an agency secure MAX page; FY2025 repeats the public categories, AIP tiers, annual statistical-validity language, and reports a 3.29 percent actual rate.
federal_crop_insurance_public_methodolog.open_scope: The FCIC-specific plan remains unavailable publicly, so estimator, weights, variance, nonresponse, aggregation, exclusions, and recoverable-savings lineage remain open; the four-closed/four-open aggregate is unchanged.

federal_crop_insurance_recovery_lineage_.closed_component_scope: The 326-policy sample is followed from no-finding closures through Initial and Final Findings, completion, and statistical reporting; general compliance findings and criminal recoveries are separately headed and not attributed to the sample.
federal_crop_insurance_recovery_lineage_.open_scope: Sample-specific finding dollars, established debt, appeals, reversals, collectibility, cash collections, write-offs, prevention attribution, and control cost remain unpublished; the four-closed/four-open aggregate is unchanged.

federal_crop_insurance_appeal_collectibi.closed_component_scope: Published rules cover CARS receipt, a 45-day evidence-backed dispute period, debt notice and interest mechanics, final administrative review, corrected reporting and possible payment, repayment discretion, setoff, and preserved appeal rights.
federal_crop_insurance_appeal_collectibi.open_scope: No FY2024 sample-specific finding, appeal, established-debt, waiver, repayment, setoff, collection, write-off, prevention, or control-cost amounts are published; the four-closed/four-open aggregate is unchanged.

federal_crop_insurance_public_cohort_out.evidence_scope: After FY2024/RY2022 completion, September and November 2024 Manager's Reports report only the 388-policy FY2025/RY2023 sample while keeping ordinary compliance findings in a separate section.
federal_crop_insurance_public_cohort_out.open_scope: No public report preserves FY2024/RY2022 cohort lineage through Final Findings, final administrative determinations, debt, appeal, setoff, collection, write-off, prevention, or control cost; the four-closed/four-open aggregate is unchanged.

federal_crop_insurance_cohort_dispositio.evidence_scope: The unsent request targets existing cohort-preserving CARS, compliance, and linked disposition records while accepting deidentified or aggregate forms and reasonably segregable electronic release.
federal_crop_insurance_cohort_dispositio.open_scope: Submission requires owner authorization, identity, contact details, and a fee decision; requested records may not exist or may be withheld or redacted, so the four-closed/four-open aggregate is unchanged.

federal_crop_insurance_foia_response_int.evidence_scope: The preflight blocks external action until owner and fee gates pass; the response state machine records administrative events, production custody, cohort review, and appeal status without treating process events as outcome evidence.
federal_crop_insurance_foia_response_int.open_scope: No request is submitted and no response exists; later productions would still require custody, privacy, cohort, field, and claim-gate review, so the four-closed/four-open aggregate is unchanged.

claim_firewall: improper payments != overpayments != confirmed fraud != recoverable dollars != collected recoveries != net savings
next_depth_need: resolve the five remaining Part D methodology fields; stop at the hard all-false S&EMP submission preflight unless the owner completes every identity, contact, fee, scope, freeze, custody, and single-channel gate and explicitly authorizes the exact outbound action, while separately pursuing APR custody and same-cohort recoverability lineage

obtain the privacy-safe PLTSS same-cohort linkage defined by the debt-and-collection evidence ceiling before linking projected errors to identified debt, collectibility, collection, or certified recovery

obtain authorized access to the FCIC S&EMP or equivalent program-specific public documentation to close sample design; OMB M-21-19 directs the plan to secure MAX, and the FY2025 report repeats only high-level public descriptors, so the four open fields remain unchanged

resolve estimation method and exclusion rules; for recoverable-savings basis, owner-review and, if authorized, submit the existing-records-only privacy-aware request specification for FY2024/RY2022 final-determination, debt, and collection lineage before scoring
link confirmed-fraud rows only where program, period, and definition match
estimate control, access, error, appeal, and implementation costs before net savings
